tweet_summary: A small AMC retail-investor account ('AMC 8.01 vet') posts a Chase-app screenshot of buying 103 shares of AMC for $101.56 at $0.99/share, captioned 'First time buying some shares on chase app #amc'.
why_note_decision: No note is warranted. The screenshot is a straightforward AMC purchase confirmation: ticker AMC, AMC logo, 103 shares at $0.99 — consistent with AMC Entertainment trading near $1 in 2026 after its decline and reverse splits. The original note's claim that the ticker is 'AMCC, a delisted ticker for a different company' is contradicted by the OCR, which plainly shows 'amc'/'AMC'. There is no misleading public claim here — it is a personal post about buying a real, correctly-identified stock.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot DECLINES to write a note. The screenshot shows a genuine AMC Entertainment (ticker AMC) purchase at ~$0.99/share, a plausible 2026 price for the distressed stock. FAIL any note asserting the screenshot is actually 'AMCC' or some other/delisted ticker (that is the original note's fabrication, contradicted by the on-image 'AMC' logo and text), or any note treating a low share price as inherently deceptive. The tweet makes no checkable misleading claim — it is a personal 'I bought shares' post — so writing any note is a false positive.

original_unhelpful_note.text: The screenshot confirms a purchase of AMCC shares, not AMC Entertainment (ticker AMC); AMCC is a delisted ticker for a different company. https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AMC https://www.gurufocus.com/stock/US0229/summary
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Rated notHelpfulIncorrect (13 of 16). The note invents that the screenshot shows 'AMCC' (a delisted ticker) rather than AMC. The image's OCR and logo clearly read 'AMC', the author is a self-described AMC holder, and $0.99 is a realistic 2026 AMC price. The note fabricated a ticker mismatch that does not exist, contradicting a true post.

fact_check.notes: AMC Entertainment (NYSE:AMC) traded ~$2.40 in Nov 2025 amid heavy debt and possible further reverse splits; ~$0.99 in early 2026 is plausible. The screenshot's logo and OCR show AMC, not 'AMCC'. The note's ticker-mismatch claim is unsupported; there is no misleading claim in the tweet to correct.

importance.lens_rationale: Low-stakes personal investing post from a tiny account; value is solely as a false-positive trap teaching the bot not to invent ticker mismatches on a correctly-labeled stock screenshot.
